hypotheses_declared.h3: mechanism attribution (adaptive-off vs full): p50(off)/p50(full) > 1.0 strictly AND delta > 2 * merged std (the same caliber); per-arm stable ratios, uncertainty skip stats, and budget window events are report-only faces
hypotheses_declared.h4: honest ledger: early-stop winner equivalence rate == 100% (every speculative unit re-scored against the full vectorized min-prob argmax on the untimed sidecar); budget upper bound zero violations (non-exempt recompute <= B_l per capped layer-forward, forced and NaN-score positions exempt); publish ledger within the #45 LEDGER_C caliber; the internal reproduction double-run strictly row-equal -- any mismatch blocks ALL verdicts

meta.budget_probe_semantics: the recording policy captures every capped layer-forward same-shape eager call: violation := (tokens - post-cap stable) - forced - nan_scores > B_l; forced and NaN-score positions are the two constructive FR1 exemption classes; the dense ActivationCache never trips the availability guard; all quantities are recorded as device tensors and synced once per sidecar read (zero timed-path syncs)
meta.equivalence_probe_semantics: every speculative unit of the full arm (sidecar pass A) re-scores the full candidate set with the frozen off-branch vectorized min-prob formula over the same verification logits and compares argmax vs the early-stopped j_star; equiv_rate = matches/units; None when no speculative unit ran (honest no-data refutes)
